dataset_metadata.name: Time-series cyclic aging data on 48 commercial NMC/graphite Sanyo/Panasonic UR18650E cylindrical cells
dataset_metadata.citation: Li, W., Sengupta, N., Dechent, P., Howey, D., Annaswamy, A., Sauer, D.U. (2021). One-shot battery degradation trajectory prediction with deep learning. Journal of Power Sources, 506, 230024. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jpowsour.2021.230024
dataset_metadata.funding: EU Horizon 2020 EVERLASTING (grant 713771); German Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy (BMWi) project E2Fuels (03EIV011F)

cell_info.cell_notes: C-grade cells drawn from the same production lot; mean capacity approximately 1.85 Ah compared to A-grade nominal capacity of 2.05 Ah. Cells are commercially known as Sanyo/Panasonic UR18650E.

aging_modes.notes: All 48 cells aged under identical conditions to study intrinsic manufacturing variability. 65% of nominal capacity used as a secondary EOL criterion. One cell discarded due to incomplete capacity degradation curve. 42 cells used for model training, 5 kept for blind testing.

time_protocol.notes: One cycle consists of 30 min discharging to 3.5 V and 30 min charging to 3.9 V, both current limited to maximum 1 A. Charge turnover approximately 1 Ah per cycle, corresponding to approximately 20-80% SOC. Tests started in batches of four cells every two to three days. On average 160 charging-discharging cycles per cycling round between checkups. Average EOL80 at approximately 1175 cycles; average EOL65 at approximately 1350 cycles; average knee-point at approximately 1088 cycles.

rawdata.data_quality_notes: Raw dataset consists of individual CSV files with time-series data for every tested cell.
rawdata.known_issues: Measurement equipment limitations caused tests to be started in batches of four cells every two to three days, resulting in slight time shifts between cells.

checkup.notes: RPT includes capacity tests and pulse resistance tests at 25°C at three voltage levels corresponding to approximately 30%, 50% and 70% SOC. BOL characterization test included multi-pulse test, capacity test, and qOCV test. EIS measurements also performed at BOL but not included in RPT. Charging in checkup performed with 2 A CC until 4.1 V, then CV until current below 40 mA; discharging with 2 A CC until 3.0 V. No impedance measurements in RPT. On average 17 characterization tests per cell over its lifetime.

notes: Dataset published under DOI: 10.18154/RWTH-2021-04545. Raw data (Rawdata.zip) available at https://publications.rwth-aachen.de/record/818642/files/Rawdata.zip. Processed dataset and code available at https://git.rwth-aachen.de/isea/battery-degradation-trajectory-prediction. The cycling methodology uses voltage-limited half-cycles to reflect real-world operating regimes and to reduce influence of test equipment variation. The dataset is specifically designed to explore intrinsic manufacturing variability under identical aging conditions, not multi-stress-factor aging.
